question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The reasons or intentions that cause a particular set of beliefs or actions
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rationale**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rationale"** refers to the reasons or intentions that cause a particular set of beliefs or actions. (तर्क)

 
 
• **Example: **The **rationale **behind the new policy was to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for the given group of words is **'Rationale'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Practical** (व्यावहारिक): Concerned with actual use or practice, rather than with theory or ideas.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a very **practical **approach to solving problems.
 
 
 
• **Thinkable** (सोचने योग्य): Capable of being thought or imagined.
 
 
• **Example: **It is **thinkable **that we might find a solution to this problem soon.
 
 
 
• **Motive** (प्रेरणा): A reason for doing something, especially one that is hidden or not obvious.
 
 
• **Example:** The detective was trying to understand the suspect's **motive **for committing the crime.
